title: agent-workflow.yaml
description: Schema for the optional per-repository agent-workflow.yaml override file. Fields are added incrementally as backlog items consume them; unknown top-level fields are permitted today so partial configs do not break.

workRecord.description: Selects the Work Record backend and its options. Bootstrap proposes the values; the human confirms.

backend.description: Which backend the skill and CI checker use to read and write the Work Record.

local.description: Options for the local Markdown backend. Required when backend is local.

taskPath.description: Repo-relative path template for the per-task Work Record file. {slug} is substituted from the branch or PR. Example: .agent-workflow/tasks/{slug}.md

jira.description: Options for the Jira backend. Field shape reserved here; full validation lands with W18.

requiredForBranchChanges.description: When true (default), the CI checker emits a blocking `workrecord.required_for_branch_changes` predicate if a PR touched code paths but resolved no Work Record at the branch slug. Set to false to allow pure-housekeeping PRs (e.g. vendored-script bumps, formatter passes) to exit clean without a Work Record.

redline.description: Whether the harness requires agent-redline. 'required' (the default) treats a missing redline verdict at PR time as a CI configuration error. 'optional' lets the checker proceed with an advisory when the verdict is unavailable. Scalar enum, not an object.

redlineVerdictPath.description: Path the CI checker reads to find redline's verdict artifact. Repo-relative or absolute. Default when omitted: 'build/redline-verdict.json'.

hooks.description: Options for the Claude Code accelerator hooks bootstrap installs (a non-normative, harness-specific nudge; CI remains the enforcement floor).

guardedPaths.description: Path prefixes the plan-mode gate hook treats as guarded code. When a plan touches any of these, the gate requires the plan to include the Work Record step. Bootstrap detects the repo's code roots and sets this; if omitted the hook defaults to ["src/"]. Matched on a path boundary, case-insensitively.
